name: Apple iTunes Search API
description: Metadata for everything in Apple's stores - apps, music, podcasts, books, films - by keyword or by id, up to 200 results per query, with no key. For apps it returns price, category, developer, version history dates, description, screenshots, average rating and rating count. The practical census tool for App Store research.

license.name: Apple public endpoint; terms permit use for referral and discovery
license.redistribution: metadata used for research is normal practice; do not republish in bulk as a competing catalogue

access.rate_limit: about 20 calls/minute is the commonly cited ceiling; heavy bursts get throttled
access.pagination: none - limit maxes at 200, so you widen the keyword list instead of paging

recipes.title: Census a keyword space

gotchas.trap: userRatingCount is the US storefront only, while averageUserRating is lifetime across all versions. Dividing one by the other mixes two populations.
gotchas.fix: Use userRatingCountForCurrentVersion when you want a like-for-like pair, and say which you used.

gotchas.trap: 200 results is a hard ceiling per query with no paging.
gotchas.fix: Cover the space with many keywords and deduplicate on trackId.
